mapper.sql: STORE.ID AS STORE_ID, STORE.CODE AS STORE_CODE, STORE.NAME AS STORE_NAME, BRAND.NAME AS STORE_BRAND, SUPERVISOR.NAME AS STORE_SUPERVISOR, STORE.C_STOREATTRIB5_ID AS BRAND_ID, STORE.C_STOREATTRIB6_ID AS SUPERVISOR_ID, STORE.ISSTOP AS STORE_IS_STOP, STORE.HT_AREA AS STORE_HT_AREA, STORE.PROP_TYPE AS STORE_PROP_TYPE, STORE.GROUP_NAME AS STORE_GROUP_NAME, STORE.CHANNEL_FORMAT AS STORE_CHANNEL_FORMAT, STORE.MALL_NAME AS STORE_MALL_NAME
FROM C_STORE STORE LEFT JOIN C_STOREATTRIBVALUE BRAND ON STORE.C_STOREATTRIB5_ID = BRAND.ID LEFT JOIN C_STOREATTRIBVALUE SUPERVISOR ON STORE.C_STOREATTRIB6_ID = SUPERVISOR.ID
mapper.select: SELECT CODE, NAME FROM C_STORE ORDER BY CODE
SELECT ID, NAME FROM C_STOREATTRIBVALUE WHERE DIMFLAG = 'DIM5' ORDER BY NAME
SELECT ID, NAME FROM C_STOREATTRIBVALUE WHERE DIMFLAG = 'DIM6' ORDER BY NAME
mapper.update: UPDATE C_STORE SET C_STOREATTRIB5_ID = NULLIF(TRIM(#{brandId}), ''), C_STOREATTRIB6_ID = NULLIF(TRIM(#{supervisorId}), ''), ISSTOP = NULLIF(TRIM(#{isStop}), ''), HT_AREA = NULLIF(TRIM(#{htArea}), ''), PROP_TYPE = NULLIF(TRIM(#{propType}), ''), GROUP_NAME = NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupName}), ''), CHANNEL_FORMAT = NULLIF(TRIM(#{channelFormat}), ''), MALL_NAME = NULLIF(TRIM(#{mallName}), '') WHERE ID = #{storeId}
